title: Paying Creators for Training Data Can Increase AI Displacement
abstract: arXiv:2611.20204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI increasingly competes with creators while using their content as training data. In response, policymakers have called for platforms to compensate creators for training data use and allow opting out. We study how such policies affect creator displacement in a model of a platform where creators choose whether to contribute training data and consumers choose between purchasing from creators and prompting generative AI trained on their content. When compensation is required, the low-quality creator chooses to remain solely as a training data supplier while AI fully displaces her demand, despite AI quality and the price the platform charges for AI-generated content being identical with and without compensation. Without compensation, the risk of losing creators and their training data constrains the platform to set the price of creators' content to preserve their demand. translated_title: 为训练数据向创作者付费可能会加剧AI对创作者的取代
translated_abstract: 生成式AI日益与创作者形成竞争，同时将创作者的内容用作训练数据。对此，政策制定者呼吁平台就训练数据的使用向创作者支付报酬，并允许创作者选择退出。我们研究此类政策如何影响创作者被AI取代的问题，构建了一个平台模型：创作者选择是否提供训练数据，消费者则在从创作者处购买内容与使用基于其内容训练的生成式AI之间进行选择。研究表明，当要求平台支付报酬时，低质量创作者会选择仅作为训练数据提供者，其需求被AI完全取代——尽管无论是否支付报酬，AI的质量和平台对AI生成内容收取的价格都是完全相同的。而在不支付报酬的情况下，失去创作者及其训练数据的风险会约束平台，迫使平台将创作者内容的价格设定在能够维持创作者需求的水平。这一约束同时也阻止了AI对创作者的进一步取代……
tldr: 这篇论文揭示了一个反直觉的结论：要求平台为训练数据向创作者付费这一看似保护创作者的政策，反而会使低质量创作者自愿转变为纯粹的训练数据提供者、被AI完全取代，因为失去创作者的威胁本是抑制AI扩张的关键市场约束。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a counterintuitive result: requiring platforms to compensate creators for training data can paradoxically increase AI displacement, as low-quality creators willingly become pure training data suppliers once compensated, removing the threat of losing creators that otherwise constrains the platform from expanding AI adoption.
